title: Policy Matrix
description: Effective role x action authorization matrix derived from the policy bundle currently loaded by the gateway (SPEC-019 R-2). Read-only transparency surface; never a source of authority — enforcement stays with the policy engine.

version.description: The version field of the loaded policy bundle.

source.description: Where the loaded bundle came from: the configured policy path or the packaged default.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the exact loaded bundle text, computed at load time — never authored in the bundle (SPEC-048 R-1). Lets a live check confirm the enforced bundle matches the intended canonical file.

scope.description: platform-admin receives every role row (full); every other identity receives only its granted roles (own).

roles.description: The roles with rows in this response, sorted.

actions.description: The action catalog (bundle actions union protected route actions), sorted.

matrix.description: role -> action -> allow (true) or not immediately allowed (false), evaluated with full policy semantics. Cells answering require_approval read false here and appear in approval_requirements (SPEC-030 R-5).

approval_requirements.description: Additive third cell state (SPEC-030 R-5): role -> action -> approval requirement for cells evaluating require_approval, carrying the tier and the designated decider roles. Absent roles/actions have no approval requirement.

tier.description: The approval tier of the matched require_approval rule.

decided_by_roles.description: Roles designated to decide this approval.

rule_id.description: The matched require_approval rule id, when one matched.
